# Auth lock commands expose the lock-mode surface and autostart the daemon when
# no daemon is running.
spacewave auth lock --help
stdout "lock the session (bare) or configure lock mode (pin, auto, status)"
stdout "lock session with a PIN"
stdout "set session to auto-unlock mode"
stdout "show current lock mode and locked state"

! spacewave auth lock --state-path $WORK/state
stderr "no session found at index 1"

! spacewave auth lock status --state-path $WORK/state
stderr "no session found at index 1"
